note: Whether each cited work supports the sentence it is cited in. Judgements made by reading the deposited abstract; 'no abstract retrieved' is recorded as such rather than assumed. This is the layer a DOI check cannot reach: an identifier can resolve and the metadata can match while the citation still points at a paper that does not say what the sentence needs.
